title: A list length bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and let $y$ be a finite Boolean string. If $W$ is the machine-dependent quantity defined by the codec, then $|y| \le (8W+8)(|y|+1)$.
